title: harnessbench model-run manifest (model bench lane)
description: Manifest for runs/<id>/run.json whose kind is "model": one engine/quantization tuning round of a single local model, or one agentic showdown round (optional `agentic` block). Measurement rows live in data/model_results.json (schemas/model_results.schema.json).

slug.description: served model id as recorded by the capture

quant.description: quantization build under test, as recorded

family.description: local | hosted — what the number was produced on

engine.description: inference engine and how it was reached (never a flag list: legs are recorded without their settings)

verdict.description: manual decision recorded for the round; INFO when the capture recorded none. Showdown rounds read from the recorded score instead: PASS (>=3 resolved of 10), PARTIAL (1-2), INFO (0)

agentic.description: Present only on agentic showdown rounds (mini-swe-agent x SWE-bench Verified): the outcome tally of one model over the instance set. Tuning rounds never carry it. Counts come from the official swebench eval report JSONs, per-instance credit from the partial-credit re-score tables.

steps_cap.description: agent step cap for the round; null when the capture did not record it

temperature.description: sampling temperature; null when the capture did not record it

n_instances.description: instances in the set (the sb10 set is 10)

resolved.description: instances the official eval marked resolved

unresolved.description: instances with a submitted patch that the official eval did not resolve

empty.description: empty patches: no submission, in practice the step cap hit without one

partial_credit.description: sum of per-instance F2P fraction over the set (resolved 1.0, empty 0); null when this round was never re-scored

gpu_hours.description: agent-phase wall time in GPU hours, as the capture recorded it

resolved_per_gpu_h.description: resolved per GPU hour, as the capture recorded it

perf.description: Agent-phase performance of the round, recorded as the capture measured it and copied verbatim into the manifest — nothing here is re-derived from other fields. A property is null (or absent) when the capture did not record it: the 2026-11-10 final2 rounds have no activity dump, so only the RESULTS.md prose medians survive and the manifest notes say what they are not. Speed and request counts only — never a quality claim.

requests.description: completion requests answered inside the agent-phase window

in_tokens.description: prompt tokens counted over that window

out_tokens.description: generated tokens counted over that window

encode_avg.description: mean prompt tok/s over the window's requests

encode_med.description: median prompt tok/s over the window's requests

decode_avg.description: mean generated tok/s over the window's requests

decode_med.description: median generated tok/s over the window's requests

cache_pct.description: KV-cache hit share of prompt tokens, percent

mtp_acc_pct.description: MTP draft-token acceptance, percent; null when the build ran no MTP or reported none

max_out.description: longest single response in the window, output tokens — read it against cap_tokens

errors.description: non-200 responses inside the window; a clean window records 0, null when the window was never swept

phase_wall_s.description: agent-phase window length in seconds, as the capture windowed it

cap_tokens.description: max_tokens the round was configured with — the ceiling max_out is read against

vram_gib.description: VRAM the served build held on the rig, GiB; recorded only for the builds the comparison table measured

instance.description: SWE-bench instance id, verbatim as the eval recorded it

result.description: official eval report JSON for this instance; no report at all means no patch was submitted

steps.description: agent steps used; null when the capture did not record it for this instance

credit.description: F2P fraction from the partial-credit table; null when this round was never re-scored

patch.description: a patch was submitted; null when the capture did not record it
